digest.component_or_area: Jira DC live reconciliation verification (rebar reconciler)
propositions: The epic's headline AC — that rebar reconciles bidirectionally against a Dockerized Jira DC instance — must be proven live against a copy of the real ticket store rather than an empty store, since a converged pass over empty input proves nothing.

The store copy must be hard-isolated (separate git repo with no remote, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, no Cloud credentials) and scrubbed of all .bridge_state* binding/snapshot artifacts, with both properties asserted rather than assumed.

Every DC-side mutation (14 inbound, 14 outbound) must round-trip and be asserted individually against a named per-mutation oracle, with set_parent's epic case asserted directly against the transport as NotImplementedError since dispatch_one swallows the exception.

Outbound update passes must be scoped with --filter-local-ids and share a bound_dc_issue fixture, because the scrub removes bindings and unbound tickets route to the create path, which would spuriously file the whole store into the harness.

Pagination is a remote-side property requiring seeding 2*observed+1 issues in the harness (observing the effective page size) and asserting full recovery, and index lag must be settled before asserting to avoid false truncation signatures.

The thin vertical slice and headline inbound/outbound cells are proven green live at 26/26, but the comprehensive mutation suite, idempotence, pagination, positive inbound-identity minting, and the base_url file-content check remain unimplemented so the story is still in progress.
